source_metadata.title: In vivo acquired daptomycin resistance during treatment of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus endocarditis
source_metadata.source_type: case report / single-patient longitudinal clinical and microbiologic observation

batch_manifest.semantic_scope: entire two-page case report excluding bibliography as evidence; Figure 1 visually reconciled

atoms.canonical_statement: The case report describes emergence of a daptomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolate during daptomycin treatment of right-sided infective endocarditis in a patient with no prior vancomycin treatment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This clinical case reports the emergence of a daptomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolate during daptomycin treatment in a patient with right-sided infective endocarditis who had never been treated with vancomycin.

atoms.canonical_statement: The patient was a 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and transferred to the ICU for mechanical ventilation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease was hospitalized for an acute respiratory decompensation. The patient was immediately transferred to the intensive care unit where mechanical ventilation was established.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with COPD and MRSA right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: Three days before hospital transfer, empiric pneumonia treatment consisted of amoxicillin-clavulanate 3 g/day and levofloxacin 100 mg/day; amoxicillin-clavulanate was continued for 7 days.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Three days before her hospital transfer, the patient had been treated empirically for pneumonia with amoxicillin–clavulanate (3 g/day) and levofloxacin (100 mg/day). The amoxicillin–clavulanate treatment was continued for 7 days.

exposures.details: Empiric pneumonia treatment started three days before hospital transfer
Empiric pneumonia treatment started three days before hospital transfer

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 13, bronchoalveolar lavage was positive for Aspergillus and MRSA during another severe septic pulmonary episode.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At day 13 post-hospitalization, a bronchoalveolar lavage was collected when another acute episode of severe septic pulmonary syndrome occurred. This sample was positive for Aspergillus and MRSA.

atoms.canonical_statement: The day-13 bronchoalveolar lavage findings led to linezolid 1200 mg/day for 10 days and voriconazole 400 mg/day for 3 months.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This sample was positive for Aspergillus and MRSA, leading to a treatment with linezolid (1200 mg/day) for 10 days and voriconazole (400 mg/day) for 3 months.

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 52, the patient had MRSA catheter-related bacteremia associated with hypovolemia.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At day 52 post-hospitalization, daptomycin treatment (7 mg/kg) was started for an MRSA catheter-related bacteremia associated with hypovolemia (Figure 1).

atoms.canonical_statement: Daptomycin 7 mg/kg was started on hospital day 52 for MRSA catheter-related bacteremia.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At day 52 post-hospitalization, daptomycin treatment (7 mg/kg) was started for an MRSA catheter-related bacteremia associated with hypovolemia (Figure 1).

atoms.canonical_statement: Because bacteremia persisted and daptomycin MIC increased, daptomycin was increased to 16 mg/kg/day and rifampin 1200 mg/day was added for possible synergy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Consequently, the daptomycin dose was increased to 16 mg/kg/day and associated with rifampin (1200 mg/day) for possible synergy.

atoms.canonical_statement: After an additional 8 days of daptomycin 16 mg/kg/day plus rifampin, bacteremia persisted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Despite additional 8 days of this therapy, the bacteremia persisted

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 68, therapy was switched to vancomycin 3 g/day by continuous infusion, gentamicin 4 mg/kg/day, and linezolid 1200 mg/day.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At 68 days of hospitalization, the antibiotic treatment was switched to a combination of vancomycin (3 g/day continuous infusion), gentamicin (4 mg/kg/day), and linezolid (1200 mg/day).

atoms.canonical_statement: After the switch to vancomycin, gentamicin, and linezolid, blood cultures remained negative.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: From then, blood cultures remained negative.

atoms.canonical_statement: Gentamicin was discontinued after 5 days, linezolid after 12 days, and vancomycin was continued for 6 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Gentamicin and linezolid were discontinued after 5 days and 12 days, respectively (Figure 1). Vancomycin was continued for 6 weeks

atoms.canonical_statement: During the 6-week vancomycin course, reported vancomycin blood concentrations remained between 25 and 35 mg/L.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Vancomycin was continued for 6 weeks, with controls of blood concentrations showing values remaining between 25 and 35 mg/l.

atoms.canonical_statement: MICs for the representative S. aureus isolates were determined using E-test and broth dilution methods and interpreted according to EUCAST guidelines.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) were determined using the E-test and broth dilution methods, and interpreted as susceptible (S) or resistant (R) in accordance with EUCAST guidelines.

atoms.canonical_statement: The daptomycin-susceptible pretreatment isolate and daptomycin-resistant strain were compared for mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, and yycG.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A comparison of our daptomycin-susceptible isolate (pre-treatment) and the daptomycin-resistant strain did not detect mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, and yycG genes

atoms.canonical_statement: Comparison of the pretreatment susceptible and resistant isolates did not identify mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG except a single mutation in the rpoB region known to confer rifampin resistance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: did not detect mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, and yycG genes, except a single mutation within the region of the rpoB gene known to confer resistance to rifampin.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that the molecular mechanism of the observed daptomycin resistance remained undetermined.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The molecular mechanism of this daptomycin resistance trait remains to be determined.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors stated that, to their knowledge, this was the first reported de novo development of daptomycin resistance with clinical failure during endocarditis therapy without previous vancomycin treatment and without de novo mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To the best of our knowledge, this clinical case is the first regarding the de novo development of daptomycin resistance with clinical failure to cure MRSA during endocarditis therapy, without previous treatment with vancomycin and without any de novo mutation in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG genes.
